content_preview:
# Checkpoint Engine 配置
# 检查点引擎 — 零Token断电续传
# 命名空间: NGT-CHECK-v1.0-FIN-260327

version: "1.0"
description: "差分持久化检查点引擎，确保状态永生"

checkpoint:
  # 触发条件
  triggers:
    - type: "token_threshold"
      value: 80  # Token消耗达80%时自动触发
    - type: "time_interval"
      value: 300  # 每5分钟检查一次
    - type: "manual"
      command: "/checkpoint save"
  
  # 存储层级
  storage_tiers:
    tier_1_hot:
      location: "ram_disk"
      format: "binary_diff"
      retention: "session"
      wal_enabled: true
